# PRP — P1.M1.T4.S1 — SessionRuntime map + seq counter + baseline + lastFiltered cache

## Goal

**Feature Goal:** Provide the in-memory, per-session, non-persisted control-state map that every downstream
Mulligan module reads/writes: a monotonic `seq` counter (for deterministic marker ordering across reload),
a `tokenBaseline` (for the turn-metric delta), a `lastTurnIndex`, and the cached `lastFiltered` view (what
the model actually saw on the last inference, so `mulligan_audit` can report the filtered view without
re-running the pipeline — D5). Held in a `Map<string, SessionRuntime>` keyed by sessionId, created/reset on
`session_start`, never caching a `sessionManager` handle across turns (C12).

**Deliverable:** `src/runtime.ts` exporting `runtime()`, `nextSeq()`, `resetRuntime()`, `clearAll()`, the
`SessionRuntime` interface, a re-exported `AgentMessage` opaque alias, plus `test/runtime.test.ts`.

**Success Definition:** `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; `npx vitest run test/runtime.test.ts` green; `pi -e ./src/index.ts -p hi`
still loads the no-op extension without error. Module imports nothing (Pi-free). Contract field shape exact.

## Why

- **Why now / scope:** This is Step 1 of the spec build order (spec/11 §2). `seq` is consumed by markers.ts
  (P1.M3.T1), which stamps it INTO every persisted marker (spec/04 §3) so the `context` filter orders markers
  deterministically with `stableSortBySeq` even if `ts` ties (spec/06 §1). `lastFiltered` is written by
  filter.ts (P1.M3.T2) and read by tools/audit.ts (P1.M4.T4) — it is THE mechanism that makes `mulligan_audit`
  report the *filtered* view rather than Pi's `getContextUsage()` (which counts hidden tokens — D5,
  spec/02 §7). `tokenBaseline`/`lastTurnIndex` roll forward at `turn_end` (nudges.ts, P1.M3.T3).
- **Boundaries (do NOT cross):** This task PROVIDES the API only. Do NOT import runtime.ts from index.ts, do
  NOT register any handler/tool, do NOT add fields beyond the 7 specified, do NOT add `pendingBloatHits`
  (that is nudges.ts scope, P1.M3.T3), do NOT add `shrinkMissCounts`/`aboveHighWater`/`rewindRefusedTurnIndex`
  (those are P3/P4 scope — the sibling oracle has them; this task must NOT). Wiring into index.ts is P1.M7.T1.

## What

A pure TypeScript module, no Pi/config/log imports. Public API:
- `runtime(sessionId | ctx): SessionRuntime` — get-or-create; returns the SAME mutable live object per
  sessionId until reset/clearAll. Accepts a plain string OR `{ getSessionId(): string }`.
- `nextSeq(rt): number` — pre-increment `rt.seq` and return the new value (first call → 1). NEVER takes a
  sessionId; takes the runtime object obtained from `runtime(...)`.
- `resetRuntime(sessionId): void` — drop one entry; next `runtime(sessionId)` is fresh (seq 0). No-op if absent.
- `clearAll(): void` — wipe the whole map. No-op if empty. (Tests MUST call this in beforeEach.)

### Success Criteria
- [ ] `SessionRuntime` has EXACTLY 7 fields: `{ sessionId, seq, tokenBaseline, lastTurnIndex, lastFiltered, lastFilterTs }` — no more.
- [ ] `runtime("s1") === runtime("s1")` is reference-equal (the live mutable object).
- [ ] `nextSeq` is strictly increasing per session (1,2,3…), persists on `rt.seq`, and distinct sessions are independent.
- [ ] `runtime({ getSessionId: () => "s1" }) === runtime("s1")` (ctx-vs-string parity).
- [ ] In-place mutation contract: `rt.lastFiltered = msgs; runtime("s1").lastFiltered === msgs` (no defensive copy).
- [ ] `resetRuntime("s1")` makes the next `runtime("s1")` a fresh object (seq 0); prior references are abandoned.
- [ ] `clearAll()` wipes everything; no-op on empty.
- [ ] Module imports NOTHING (Pi-free, config-free, log-free) — verified by `npx tsc --noEmit`.
- [ ] No public symbol throws on any input (fail-open is the codebase-wide discipline; spec/03 #4).

### Implementation Patterns & Key Details
```ts
const runtimes = new Map<string, SessionRuntime>();
function freshRuntime(sessionId: string): SessionRuntime {
  return { sessionId, seq: 0, tokenBaseline: null, lastTurnIndex: null,
           lastFiltered: null, lastFilterTs: null };
}
export function runtime(arg: string | { getSessionId(): string }): SessionRuntime {
  const sessionId = typeof arg === "string" ? arg : arg.getSessionId();
  let rt = runtimes.get(sessionId);
  if (rt === undefined) { rt = freshRuntime(sessionId); runtimes.set(sessionId, rt); }
  return rt; 
}
export function nextSeq(rt: SessionRuntime): number {
  return ++rt.seq;
}
export function resetRuntime(sessionId: string): void { runtimes.delete(sessionId); }
export function clearAll(): void { runtimes.clear(); }

```
